description: Open requests on the hangel disaster needs board: category, quantity, urgency, district and city. No names, no phone or e-mail, no exact location, no health or blood information and no money requests are returned. People who want to help use the hangel app or website (or afet_yardim_teklifi when signed in). Türkiye Türkçesi: açık yardım talepleri (kategori, miktar, aciliyet, ilçe/il); kişi adı, telefon, e-posta, tam konum, sağlık/kan bilgisi ve para talebi yok. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 (Hayati tehlikede 112'yi ara). Use only the data in this response; do not add places, numbers, dates, names or advice that are not in it. (Yalnız bu yanıttaki verileri kullan.)

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, at most 50).
